# Repository-derived repair fixtures

Four exact, licensed source files from three pinned public repositories. See
PROVENANCE.json for immutable source URLs and SHA256 hashes; licenses are kept
alongside each snapshot. Tests require no network and modify only temporary copies.

The curriculum injects deterministic faults in floor selection, iterator extent
and integer byte encoding. It adds a separate caller module and authored visible
and external audit tests. These are **seeded repository-derived projects**, not
untouched real bug reports, the complete upstream repositories, or scores on their
upstream suites. Teaching uses the pinned correct source as an expert example;
held-out variants use different seeded defects and separate external audit cases.

License text is unchanged; CRLF license line endings are normalized to LF.
The provenance manifest records original and local license hashes.
